components.name: release-skill
components.description: The EmbedThis /release skill, executed by Claude Code. Components derived from package.json (paks map and devDependencies), paks/*/package.json and node_modules/*/package.json.

properties.name: embedthis:usage
properties.value: shipped - compiled into the product

properties.name: embedthis:hash-subject
properties.value: The SHA-256 hash identifies the vendored file src/osdep/osdep.h, the whole of the osdep source compiled into the product

properties.name: embedthis:craScope
properties.value: in-scope - shipped in the product

properties.name: embedthis:usage
properties.value: not shipped and not compiled in - the self-signed test certificates and keys the repository test suite uses. A source distribution generates its own test certificates and keys when the suite runs

properties.name: embedthis:craScope
properties.value: out-of-scope - test data, not a component of the product and not shipped in the source archive

components.name: @embedthis/ejscript
components.description: Ejscript core API implementation for Bun runtime - used by the TestMe unit test suite

properties.name: embedthis:usage
properties.value: build and test only - npm devDependency used by the unit test suite; never linked into the product

properties.name: embedthis:license-status
properties.value: RESOLVED - the published npm package declares "license": "GPL-2.0-only" and ships LICENSE.md, whose text confirms GNU GPL version 2 only.

properties.name: embedthis:craScope
properties.value: out-of-scope - not part of the product placed on the market

components.name: @embedthis/testme
components.description: TestMe unit test runner - executes the GoAhead test suite

properties.name: embedthis:usage
properties.value: build and test only - npm devDependency used by the unit test suite; never linked into the product

properties.name: embedthis:license-status
properties.value: DECLARED, NOT VERIFIED - the published npm package declares "license": "GPL-2.0", a deprecated SPDX identifier, and ships no license text. Recorded verbatim as a license name rather than an SPDX id because the deprecated string does not disambiguate GPL-2.0-only from GPL-2.0-or-later; the ambiguity is not resolved here by inference. Test-only, so it creates no distribution obligation on the shipped product. Ask the upstream publisher to declare a current SPDX id and ship LICENSE.md.

properties.name: embedthis:craScope
properties.value: out-of-scope - not part of the product placed on the market

components.name: openssl
components.description: TLS provider (default). Linked from the build host or integrator toolchain; not vendored in this repository.

properties.name: embedthis:usage
properties.value: external system library - selected via premake tls=openssl (default), adapter src/openssl.c

properties.name: embedthis:version-authority
properties.value: INTEGRATOR - the concrete version is fixed at link time by the integrator's toolchain and MUST be recorded in the integrator's own SBOM. GoAhead does not pin it.

properties.name: embedthis:craScope
properties.value: in-scope - shipped in the product

properties.name: embedthis:version-authority
properties.value: INTEGRATOR - the concrete version is fixed at link time by the integrator's toolchain and MUST be recorded in the integrator's own SBOM. GoAhead does not pin it.

properties.name: embedthis:craScope

components.name: libpam
components.description: Pluggable Authentication Modules, the optional PAM password store (ME_GOAHEAD_AUTH_STORE "pam"). Linked from the operating system; not vendored in this repository.

properties.name: embedthis:usage
properties.value: external system library - compiled in when ME_COMPILER_HAS_PAM is set, which is the default on macOS only (projects/premake5.lua links pam on every macOS build), adapter src/auth.c

properties.name: embedthis:license-status
properties.value: The license is that of the platform's PAM implementation: OpenPAM (macOS, FreeBSD) is BSD-3-Clause; Linux-PAM is BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-or-later. The expression records the union; the integrator records the implementation actually linked.

properties.name: embedthis:version-authority
properties.value: INTEGRATOR - the concrete implementation and version are fixed by the target operating system and MUST be recorded in the integrator's own SBOM. GoAhead does not pin it.

properties.name: embedthis:craScope
properties.value: in-scope - shipped in the product when PAM is compiled in
